articles.title: Disaster risk reduction takes center stage in talks on global disaster treaty
articles.description: As UN Member States prepare for negotiations on a proposed international convention on the Protection of Persons in the Event of Disasters (PPED), the need for disaster prevention is emerging as a significant part of the discussion.

articles.title: Africa’s early warning experts and officials call for sustained momentum on life-saving disaster protection systems
articles.description: The Africa Early Warnings Forum, held in Addis Ababa, highlighted Africa's progress in expanding early warning systems, but with climate and disaster risks accelerating, the task now is to translate that progress into protection for everyone.

articles.title: Japan to Host Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction in Sendai City in 2027
articles.description: The Government of Japan, in partnership with the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), will host the 2027 Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction from 25 to 29 October 2027 in Sendai City, Japan.

articles.title: The Africa Multi-Hazard Early Warning System and Early Action (AMHEWAS) Programme
articles.description: Supporting Disaster Risk Reduction in Africa through a network of national and regional situation rooms.

articles.title: Partnerships & Stakeholders: Science and Technology Community
articles.description: The role of global science, academia, research and innovation is enshrined in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction where it is recognized for the catalytic, boundary-pushing and transformative potential it holds for addressing the dynamic drivers of disaster risk.

articles.title: El Niño and DRR
articles.description: A shift in the Pacific Ocean that raises the odds of drought, flood, heat and fire across large parts of the world. Few risks come with this much warning, and whether that warning is used is as much a matter of governance as of meteorology.

articles.title: Strengthening Urban Resilience and Disaster Preparedness in Alexandria
articles.description: The workshop will support Alexandria’s journey under the Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) initiative and contribute to advancing the proposed Consortium for Alexandria.
